title: Why Traffic Jams Form With Nothing in the Way
topic: Why traffic jams form with no obstacle ahead
mechanism: Above a critical density, small speed wobbles between following cars amplify (each driver brakes a bit harder than the one ahead) until cars stop, and the stop-and-go wave travels backward at about 20 km/h while the cars move forward, as a 2008 experiment with 22 cars on a 230 m ring showed; bottlenecks cause jams by raising density, but no obstacle is required.

beats.hook: You've been crawling for twenty minutes, then the road just opens up with no crash in sight
beats.story: You floor it, sure you beat the traffic
beats.rise: At the rest stop you sip coffee like a genius
beats.twist: The trucker who was behind you walks in: there was no crash, it was just everyone braking
beats.mechanism: Briefing board 22 CARS / 230 M / 30 KM/H; the ring track with 22 cars and a centre camera mast; speed sign 30 + FOLLOW SAFELY; a row of toy cars with SPEED gauges dipping more down the row; the JAM flag riding the stopped clump backward; trackside board JAM MOVES BACK 20 KM/H; a BOTTLENECK funnel model packing cars; a BRAKE pedal tap rippling brake lights down a packed row
beats.ending: Back on the night highway the brake-light wave rolls backward; twenty minutes behind, a new driver looks for the crash

seed.what: The trucker's cab in your mirror / the truck right behind your car on the highway
